alt: 2027 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 pickup truck photographed in green during Engadget's first drive review — GM's self-described most powerful and advanced Silverado ever, with a 16.3-inch touchscreen whose icons proved too small to press while driving
story: Engadget's first drive of the 2027 Chevrolet Silverado (November 5, 2026) — marketed by GM as the 'most powerful and advanced Silverado ever' with a 16.3-inch main touchscreen — found the control icons so tiny that reviewers couldn't hit the right one while driving; separately, the Super Cruise autonomous system tried to change lanes into a passing motorcycle, requiring the reviewer to grab the wheel.
why_funny: GM filled America's most macho truck with the biggest screens in the class, then made the icons so small nobody can tap them, and the AI safety feature's first highway trick was to nearly sideswipe a biker.
